audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A child's high-pitched, excited voice announces 'You er shi ke ya chi' (twenty teeth) over a bright, cheerful acoustic guitar background track. (2) A woman's gentle, clear adult voice repeats 'Er shi ke ya chi' as a playful confirmation, maintaining the warm acoustic atmosphere. (3) The child repeats the phrase 'Wo you er shi ke ya chi' with high vocal arousal and positive valence. (4) Interaction continues with alternating voices discussing cavity bugs; a distinct rhythmic wood-on-wood tapping sound (SFX) occurs as the toddler hits the table with a toy. (5) The adult warns about not turning the device off, her tone shifting to slightly authoritative but remaining friendly, while the child responds with shorter, breathless phrases. (6) The conversation pivots back to the 'cavity bug' game, with the adult mockingly saying she will eat them, followed by the child's inquisitive, rising intonation in response. (7) A soft 'Pop' sound effect plays during a transition, and the child's vocal intensity increases as she laughs and makes open-mouthed vocalizations, while the guitar BGM continues steadily to the end.
